name: Ethereum Shanghai DoS attacks
rootCause: Attackers spammed transactions calling underpriced opcodes that forced heavy disk I/O, slowing block processing dramatically during Devcon 2. Fixed by gas repricing in the Tangerine Whistle (EIP-150) and Spurious Dragon (EIP-158/161) hard forks.
